facts.text: Concord is home to the only endowed Bonner Scholarship Program in West Virginia, providing scholarships for up to 80 students engaging in community service.

sources.title: The Campus Beautiful - Concord University's Athens, WV Campus
sources.quote: The Bonner House houses the offices of the endowed Bonner Scholarship Program, one of only 22 in the nation and the only in West Virginia.

sources.title: The Campus Beautiful - Concord University's Athens, WV Campus
sources.quote: The program provides up to 80 students each year with financial scholarships to support academic endeavors at the university.
